purpose: Matched-compute true-versus-shuffled action-conditioning baseline for the CounterStrike-1K NeurIPS rebuttal.

upstream.model_contract: Full 330.5M-parameter DIAMOND-CSGO low-resolution denoiser; only CounterStrike-1K data/action adapters and experiment instrumentation differ.

action_aggregation.buttons: bitwise OR over each four-source-frame interval
action_aggregation.mouse: sum delta_pitch and delta_yaw over each four-source-frame interval

arms.true: Aligned action sequence for each video window.
arms.shuffled: Whole action sequence from a different round in the same minibatch; no fixed points, temporal order and marginals preserved.

compute_contract.gpu: 1 x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96GB
compute_contract.endpoint_rule: The endpoint is fixed at step 50000 before confirmatory test evaluation. Test metrics are not used for checkpoint selection.

confirmatory_evaluation.pairing: For every checkpoint/window/seed, all action modes use identical videos and reset to identical diffusion random draws.
confirmatory_evaluation.shuffle: Each held-out action donor is the same POV slot from a different round, using a seeded cyclic round derangement.
confirmatory_evaluation.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals clustered by round_id with 10000 replicates.
